original_target.title: Baur’s high-field disk conjecture for all higher eigenvalues

scope_comparison: Lotoreichik–Morin Theorem1 proves an asymptotic shape defect bound with a negative logB error. Line106 explicitly says it does not imply Baur's finite-flux conjecture even at large B. It cannot prove the exact disk inequality for all k>=2 and B|Omega|>=2pi k.
